data.title: Wohnbau Beispielgrund eG: apartment assignment and usage contract (Nutzungsvertrag)
data.summary: Wohnbau Beispielgrund eG, a housing cooperative, assigned Johanna Beispielacker the apartment at Siedlungsweg 18, ground floor right, effective 1 January 2027, and sent two copies of the usage contract (Nutzungsvertrag) for signature, which must be returned within 14 working days of the letter's date. The letter also notes that the next automatic direct debit for her existing contract LE-2927-996 will occur on 10 December 2026 at the unchanged amount.
data.explanation: Your housing cooperative (Genossenschaft) has assigned you the apartment at Siedlungsweg 18, ground floor right, starting 1 January 2027. They enclosed two signed copies of the usage contract (Nutzungsvertrag) that you need to sign and send back by the deadline shown, counted in working days (Monday–Saturday, excluding Sundays and public holidays) from the letter's date. If you cannot meet it, contact the cooperative promptly, as the assignment could otherwise be jeopardised. Separately, for your existing contract (LE-2927-996) the next direct debit will be collected automatically on 10 December 2026 at the same amount as before — no action is needed for that.
